input.summary: Remove the First Commercial Sale time-gate on Ono's Section 13.2 at-will termination right and fix the notice period at 90 days
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 13.2 only lets us exit at will after First Commercial Sale of both Products, so we are locked into a multi-year term through the entire development phase; our playbook requires a customer convenience right exercisable throughout the term. We have made the right available at any time on ninety (90) days' notice (longer than our usual thirty (30) days) to accommodate the Article 14 wind-down machinery.

ops.oldText: Commencing on the later of (i) [ * ] of the First Commercial Sale of the Binimetinib Product in the Ono Territory, or (ii) [ * ] of the First Commercial Sale of the Encorafenib Product in the Ono Territory, Ono shall have the right to terminate this Agreement, for any reasons by giving [ * ] advance written notice to Array
ops.newText: Ono shall have the right to terminate this Agreement at any time during the Term, in its entirety or on a Product-by-Product or country-by-country basis, for any reasons by giving ninety (90) days' advance written notice to Array
